english.title: PHV operator before journey fail to enter details of booking - London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a London private hire vehicle, before the commencement of a journey booked at a specified operating centre, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OPERATING CENTRE..), failed to enter in the record the prescribed particulars of that booking which you were required to keep in compliance with section 4(3)(b) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(3)(c) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

english.notes:
(i) Section 4(4) provides that if a London PHV operator ceases to use an operating centre specified in his licence he shall preserve any record he was required by this section to keep there for such period as may be prescribed.
(ii) Section 4(6) provides a defence in proceedings for this offence for an operator to show that he exercised all due diligence to avoid committing such an offence.
